title: Vivida — your photos, without the wait
description: Vivida is a local image browser for Windows. See your folders right away while thumbnails fill in, then open a window-sized preview.
eyebrow: A local image browser for Windows
hero_description: See your folders right away. Let the thumbnails catch up.
download_details: Windows 64-bit · Version {version} · Installs for your account
screen_alt: Vivida showing a folder of images in a dark thumbnail grid with a folders sidebar
screen_alt_2: Vivida image viewer showing a blue landscape beside a color information panel with an EXIF tab
feature_1_title: Native by design, made for your photos
feature_1_body: Built in C++ for Windows, with a direct, responsive feel that keeps the focus on your pictures.
feature_2_body: See the folder first. Up to eight workers load thumbnails as needed in the background, so browsing stays responsive.
feature_3_body: Vivida prioritizes the images in view, skipping unnecessary thumbnail work for those you cannot yet see.
formats_description: Open common photo and image files without importing a library.
footer_note: The installer does not change file associations. As an unsigned app, Vivida may trigger a Windows SmartScreen warning.
